title: Independent SFT Dataset Semantic and Integrity Audit

ragtruth_baseless_info_misclassification.issue: Records containing only baseless information were assigned verdict CONTRADICTED instead of INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/NEUTRAL

halueval_unmentioned_entity_conflation.issue: HaluEval hallucinated answers frequently introduce unmentioned entities rather than refuting passage claims, but are unconditionally labeled CONTRADICTED

g3_taxonomy_collapse.issue: Three out of five G3 outcomes are completely unrepresented (60% void)

evidence_grounded_nli.notes: Requires re-mapping baseless info from CONTRADICTED to NEUTRAL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

span_level_hallucination_detection.notes: Valid only on RAGTruth subset; HaluEval contains zero span annotations

full_five_outcome_g3_verification.notes: Blocked; 0 records for PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and UNCERTAIN

generative_structured_verification.notes: Valid for direct JSON targets; blocked for reasoning traces without teacher distillation
